desc: Ideate approaches and select direct scan over d = x - y with exact integer arithmetic.
Implement direct scan over d from 1 while d^3 < N, skipping non-divisors of N.
For each divisor d, compute m=N//d, D=12*m-3*d*d, and use math.isqrt to test perfect square.
Recover y from sqrt(D) when sqrt(D) > 3*d and (sqrt(D)-3*d) % 6 == 0, then set x=y+d and verify x^3-y^3==N.
Print first valid pair or -1, and test edge cases including samples, N=1, N=7, N=26, and large sample.
